title: Connect Four Win Detection
description_html:
Given an m x n board with some pieces already placed, the coordinates of the current move, and the player who made it ("a" or "b"), determine the result: that player wins if the move completes 4 consecutive pieces horizontally, vertically, or diagonally; otherwise the game is ongoing (or a draw if the board is full).

Input

  • the board, the move (r, c), and the player name.

Output

The result of this move: win / draw / ongoing.

Example

board row r:  . a a a a .     # player 'a' just placed the 4th 'a'
move = (r, c) of the new 'a'
----
"a wins"   (4 consecutive horizontally)

Only the last move can complete a line — scan the 4 axes from (r,c). See Notes.
